reference.criterion: Equal bytes; a difference of one only within 1e-9 of a byte boundary on the 255e scale; exact control bytes; LittleCMS within one code value
reference.method: Exact Fraction Gaussian solve of the frozen sRGB colorants, Fraction clip, 90-digit Decimal IEC 61966-2-1 encoding, floor(255e + 1/2)

offline_cmm.scope: Finite offline frozen-profile observations only. No runtime CMM dependency or universal precision claim.

scope: Finite sRGB destination observations from explicit relative D50 XYZ, with exact Fraction and Decimal bytes, a recorded one-value allowance within 1e-9 of a byte boundary, exact controls, and offline LittleCMS 2.19 bytes within one value; no source profile, image API, encoded admission, compatibility, physical bound, or production claim.
